acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG THA DAD GANG ZHIGKHYOD KYANG YIN, DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, dngos po dang mi 'gal ba dang tha dad gang zhigkhyod kyang yin, dngos po dang mi 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that that which is one and the same as the two of a pillar and a water pitcher is such that being it is contradictory to being something which is not contradictory to being a working thing.] Suppose you say that it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because (1) it is distinct from that which is such that being it is not contradictory with being a working thing, and (2) there exists no one thing which is both it [that which is one and the same as the two of a pillar and a water pitcher] and also something such that being it is not contradictory to being a working thing.
